To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the newspapers and academic bioethicians can work together, but only if they both accept the need for a constructive partnership, and only if both sides are aware that the success of the partnership relies on a meeting of four provisos, for which both sides bear responsibility.
the newspapers and academic bioethical literature have different agendas and that the former is not well placed to explore the philosophical dimensions of bioethical issues.
1. Bioethics is a philosophical discipline that is not well served by the mass media.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how bioethics can be made accessible to journalists and the public, whilst maintaining its philosophical integrity.
the relationship between bioethics and the media.
a) how journalists and bioethicists understand each other and b) how the internal goods of the two professions can best be combined in order to achieve a constructive partnership.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, if bioethical questions are to be adequately addressed, the newspapers must not be allowed to determine the agenda.

, whilst the newspapers and other media have a role to play in the public understanding and discussion of bioethical issues, they are not the appropriate vehicle for the conduct of philosophical enquiry into such issues.
bioethics and the media should not be in competition with one another, but should instead be in a partnership.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the media and bioethics are not incompatible, but rather are mutually dependent, and that the success of the relationship is dependent on the willingness of journalists to engage in the philosophical dimension of bioethics and of bioethicists to engage with the media.
bioethics needs the press, and the press needs bioethics.
we have identified the dangers of a distorted bioethical agenda and suggested a way of avoiding them.
The main takeaway from our work is that
bioethics is a discipline that has a lot to contribute to public discourse, but only if the public is willing to engage with its philosophical dimensions.
bioethical issues are best served by the media and academic ethics engaging in a partnership of mutual respect and understanding.
, in the context of a partnership between academic bioethics and the media, it is important that the internal goods of each partner be respected.
